svg.title: invoke
svg.desc: invoke: a recorded terminal session, 21 s, looping. Steps: a new shell loads the block setup wrote in ~/.bashrc / claude invoke rhizo · the example soul / claude invoke with no soul, and with one that does not exist / plain claude: the core prompt, no soul

g.text: mandrake: proxy fora do ar em 127.0.0.1:56849, esta sessão vai direto para a API (mandrake doctor)
$ clear; claude invoke; echo exit $?; cla
$ clear; claude invoke; echo exit $?; claude
$ clear; claude invoke; echo exit $?; claude in
$ clear; claude invoke; echo exit $?; claude invoke
$ clear; claude invoke; echo exit $?; claude invoke no
$ clear; claude invoke; echo exit $?; claude invoke nobod
$ clear; claude invoke; echo exit $?; claude invoke nobody; e

$ clear; claude invoke; echo exit $?; claude invoke nobody; echo ex
$ clear; claude invoke; echo exit $?; claude invoke nobody; echo exit $
claude invoke: 'nobody' is not a soul (rhizo)
